definitions.explanation: A surface that is flat and level, without curves or elevations. Used both in everyday language for flat surfaces and in mathematics and geometry for a two-dimensional plane.

examples.english: To draw a line on a flat surface.

examples.japanese: {平面|へいめん}{図|ず}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{間取|まど}り→間取り：06078_madori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: To check the floor layout on a plan view.

examples.japanese: ⟦{数学|すうがく}→数学：01442_suugaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{平面|へいめん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{交|まじ}わる→交わる：18379_majiwaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{直線|ちょくせん}→直線：05440_chokusen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: In mathematics, when two planes intersect, a straight line is formed.

notes:
A flat, two-dimensional surface. Composed of {平|へい} (flat/level) + ⟦{面|めん}→面：09933_men⟧ (surface/face). Used in everyday language, architecture, and mathematics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {平面|へいめん}{図|ず}: floor plan; plan view
- {平面|へいめん}⟦{幾何学|きかがく}→幾何学：16943_kikagaku⟧: plane geometry
- {平面|へいめん}{的|てき}: flat; two-dimensional (also figuratively: lacking depth)
- {平面|へいめん}⟦{交差|こうさ}→交差：00246_kousa⟧: at-grade intersection (roads crossing on the same level)
- {平面|へいめん}⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧: surface-level parking lot

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{立体|りったい}→立体：18797_rittai⟧: three-dimensional object — the conceptual opposite of {平面|へいめん}
- ⟦{表面|ひょうめん}→表面：03587_hyoumen⟧: surface — refers to the outer face of an object, not necessarily flat
- ⟦{水平|すいへい}→水平：04304_suihei⟧: horizontal; level — describes orientation rather than dimensionality

USAGE:
When used as a modifier ({平面|へいめん}{的|てき}), it can describe something figuratively as lacking depth or dimensionality, such as a flat, uninteresting character in a novel.
